recentItems.title: In Trump’s DC, everyone wants to be an influencer
recentItems.description: From cooking shows to parenting podcasts to reality TV, officials in and around the Trump administration are launching shows online. CNN’s Jon Sarlin reports on how influencer culture has transformed Trump’s DC.

recentItems.title: MapQuest boss 'blown away' by response after defying Trump
recentItems.description: MapQuest is making an unexpected comeback after defying Trump’s renaming of Lake Ontario to "Lake America." MapQuest General Manager Doug Berger told Erin Burnett that usage is "through the roof," with downloads surging to more than 1.5 million. "It was not intended to be a political stance...it's fun that we're talking about geography," Berger added.

recentItems.title: MapQuest to Trump's Lake America order: 'We're not changing it'
recentItems.description:
The most popular iPhone app in the US is one that few people have thought about since dial-up internet: MapQuest.

The mapping service is making a comeback on US App Stores after refusing to change Lake Ontario’s name, following President Donald Trump’s executive order rebranding it as Lake America.

recentItems.title: Did Edouard get a ‘brown ocean’ boost?
recentItems.description: Southeast Texas saw life-threatening flooding even as storm Edouard lost steam. Online speculation said “brown ocean effect” aided the rain, but the simpler explanation was right next door.

recentItems.title: Thousands protest Spain’s border crisis
recentItems.description: Nationwide protests erupted in Spain in support of Ceuta, following last month’s mass migrant influx from Morocco. CNN’s Clarissa Ward reports from the Spanish exclave of Ceuta.

recentItems.title: Growing concern inside Pentagon over Hegseth’s focus on culture wars
recentItems.description: Multiple sources shared concerns with CNN that Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth is damaging the Army’s efforts to modernize and adapt to the 21st century battlefield environment – where drone warfare is becoming increasingly important – by firing or pushing out leaders who were spearheading those efforts. CNN’s Haley Britzky reports.
